title: 理由与例子
goal: 能选择支持立场的理由，并用解释和具体例子说明理由如何成立。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 写作

points.label: 给出与立场一致的理由
用解释和例子展开理由

body.p: 展开一条理由有三个部分。理由是支持立场的依据。解释说明依据和立场有什么关系。例子把这种关系放进具体的情境。三个部分不必各占一句，但依据和立场之间的联系要写出来。

body.box:
Position: A campus should lend musical instruments.
Reason: Borrowing can make trying an instrument less costly.
Explanation: Beginners can find out whether they enjoy playing before purchasing an instrument.
Example: A student could borrow a violin for an introductory course and buy one only after deciding to continue.

body.p: 这个例子支持的是尝试的成本降低，不证明所有学生都会坚持练习。多加人物或时间，论证不会因此更有力。细节要显示理由怎样成立。

cards.title: 理由的展开
rows: 理由
说明这个做法的一个作用，不只说好或不好。
Instrument loans reduce the cost of trying music.
解释
说明这个作用怎样发生，不另起一个理由。
A beginner can postpone buying an instrument until after a trial.
具体对象
给例子一个具体的人。只写人名不算证据。
A student joining an introductory violin course could borrow a violin.
具体行动
写这个人在新做法下能做什么。
The student could attend the course without purchasing equipment.
相关结果
结果回到原来的理由，不扩大成普遍结论。
An unsuitable instrument would not become an expensive unused purchase.
适用范围
写明例子适用于哪些人，不说人人如此。
This would help beginners who are unsure about continuing.

cards.title: 例子的来源
rows: 个人经历
写清经历里做了什么、结果如何。不写成调查数据。
In my first pottery class, shared tools let me try carving before buying a set.
常识
选和理由直接相关的日常事实。
A larger table gives a group more space to spread out paper plans.
假设情境
用 could、if、suppose 标明尚未发生。
If a tutor offered an evening slot, a working student could attend.
空泛例子
写了 for example，内容仍可能不具体。
For example, many people benefit. → 未说明对象如何受益。
改写后的例子
补上与理由有关的行动和结果。
A commuter could collect a parcel after work instead of missing delivery.
不相干细节
地点、颜色说明不了作用。
The parcel locker is blue. → 不能解释领取时间的便利。

body.box:
Professor: Should a town provide shaded seating at outdoor markets?
Draft: I support shaded seating because it is convenient. For example, markets are convenient places.

body.p: 草稿的理由只有 convenient，例子又重复了这个评价。修改时要说明座椅和遮阴怎样改变逛市场的过程。

body.box: Revision: I support shaded seating because visitors need somewhere to pause between stalls. A seat under a canopy would let someone rest without leaving the market. For example, a visitor carrying several bags could sit down, reorganize them, and then continue shopping.

body.p: 理由：提供中途休息的地方。解释：休息时不必离开市场。例子：提着几个袋子的顾客坐下整理，然后继续购物。这个假设推不出市场销售额一定增加。

body.box:
Which detail directly supports the reason?
1. The canopy matches the market's signs.
2. The visitor can pause without leaving the market.
3. Several stalls sell bags in different colors.
4. The market signs identify each stall.

body.p: 答案是第二项，它说明座位怎样满足休息的需要。其余三项与市场有关，但和休息无关。

groups.text:
Position: A research course should include a small pilot project before the main study.
Reason: A pilot can reveal unclear instructions.
Situation: Participants in a trial interpret a question in two different ways; the researcher can revise it before collecting the main data.

items.stem: Which explanation connects the reason to the position?
options: The main study should repeat the unclear question unchanged.
Different interpretations make a pilot unnecessary for research.
A trial exposes wording problems while revision is still possible.
The main study can reveal unclear wording after all the data are collected.
items.why: revise it before collecting the main data 说明试做能在正式收集前发现并修改问题。

groups.text:
Position: A district should keep a walk-in help desk for transit passes.
Reason: Some passengers struggle with the application form.
Example: A passenger brings an incomplete form, receives help with the required fields, and submits it before leaving.

items.stem: Which part makes the example support the reason?
options: The passenger brings an incomplete form to the desk in the district.
The passenger completes the difficult form with assistance.
The help desk offers the same form as other locations.
The form contains fields that passengers must complete.
items.why: receives help ... and submits it 展示了现场协助怎样解决填表困难，即第二项。第一项只说乘客带着没填完的表来，没有说明困难怎样解决。

groups.text:
Position: A campus should introduce covered bicycle storage.
Evidence: In open racks, bags left on bicycles can get wet during rain; a roof would shelter them.

items.stem: Which reason is directly supported by this evidence?
options: A cover could protect stored belongings from rainfall.
A roof could eliminate the need for bicycle racks.
Rain makes every bicycle unsuitable for commuting.
Covered racks would require cyclists to remove their bags.
items.why: a roof would shelter them 支持保护物品免受雨淋；没有说明取消车架或禁止留包。

groups.text:
Reason: Publishing a restaurant's ingredients helps diners avoid foods they cannot eat.
Example: A diner who avoids sesame checks the list and chooses a dish without sesame.

items.stem: Why does the example develop the reason?
options: It proves that every ingredient list contains sesame.
It explains why restaurants should remove all sesame dishes.
It shows diners checking ingredients only after a dish has been served.
It shows information guiding a choice under a dietary restriction.
items.why: checks the list and chooses a dish without sesame 展示成分信息如何支持有饮食限制的人作选择。

groups.text:
Position: A university should offer short orientation walks for new staff.
Draft: Walks would help staff locate essential services. The walks would also be helpful and useful.

items.stem: Which addition explains the stated reason?
options: Essential services should replace orientation walks for staff.
Seeing the route to payroll once makes later visits easier.
Useful walks are helpful whenever staff attend orientation.
Staff who already know payroll should guide every walk.
items.why: locate essential services 需要说明怎样认路。第二项写出走过一次去 payroll 的路线，以后就容易找到。

groups.text:
Claim: A shared calendar could prevent overlapping bookings of a rehearsal room.
Situation: Two groups want the room on Friday; one sees the existing booking and selects Saturday.

items.stem: Which conclusion is supported by this hypothetical example?
options: Shared calendars ensure that no rehearsal is ever canceled.
Friday rehearsals always attract more groups than Saturday ones.
Visible bookings could help a group choose an available time.
The room should remain unused whenever two groups request it.
items.why: sees the existing booking and selects Saturday 展示了可见信息如何避免冲突；单个假设不能保证永不取消。

items.stem: A school should label identical storage boxes so materials can be found without opening each box.
items.why: make it easier to identify 说明标签的作用；the contents of each storage box 对应需要寻找的材料。

items.stem: A college should offer practice interviews because applicants can discover unclear answers before meeting employers.
items.why: an opportunity to identify answers that need clarification 将练习与提前发现问题联系起来。

items.stem: A self-service ticket machine could shorten a queue by allowing visitors to buy tickets without waiting for the cashier.
items.why: 例子把缩短队列具体化为访客使用机器购票；use ... to purchase 表示手段和行动。

items.stem: A lending service could help beginning photographers test equipment before buying it.
items.why: borrow a lens to test its suitability 对应先试用后购买，具体行动直接支持理由。

groups.text:
Position: A university should provide temporary storage for students moving between leases.
Reason: Their old and new rental periods may not connect.
Explanation: A secure place to leave belongings would let students manage the interval without discarding usable possessions.
Example: Suppose a student's old lease ends on Monday and the next begins on Thursday. Storing a desk during those days would let the student keep it for the new room.

items.stem: Which reason best preserves the argument for temporary storage?
options: It would allow students to extend every expired rental contract.
It would remove the need to transport furniture between rooms.
It would help students handle a gap between housing arrangements.
It would encourage students to replace possessions when moving.
items.why: old and new rental periods may not connect 对应 a gap between housing arrangements，即第三项。储存物品不是延长租约。

items.stem: Which detail makes the example support that reason?
options: The student uses the desk while staying in the storage area.
The student signs two leases for rooms of equal size.
The student's furniture becomes unnecessary after Monday.
The desk can be kept during the days between the leases.
items.why: Storing a desk during those days ... keep it 说明临时储存如何避免在租约空档丢弃物品。

groups.text:
Position: A city should publish clear route maps for temporary street diversions.
Reason: A closure notice alone does not explain how to reach the same destination.
Explanation: A map could identify a usable alternative route.
Example: A delivery rider who encounters a closed lane could follow the marked side street and rejoin the original route beyond the closure.

items.stem: Which reason matches the position and explanation?
options: Alternative-route information would make closures easier to navigate.
Closure notices would remove the need to use side streets.
A map would prevent temporary street closures from occurring.
Delivery riders would no longer need to know their destination in advance.
items.why: identify a usable alternative route 对应使封路后的绕行更容易；地图不能防止封路发生。

items.stem: Which feature gives the example explanatory value?
options: It mentions a rider without describing any route choice.
It shows how a marked alternative still reaches the intended route.
It proves that side streets are always faster than main roads.
It changes the destination to avoid explaining the closure.
items.why: follow the marked side street and rejoin the original route 显示替代路线如何解决通行问题。

items.stem: Written assembly instructions could help volunteer builders avoid guessing the sequence of steps.
items.why: reduce the need to guess the correct sequence 说明文字说明与减少猜测之间的联系。

items.stem: A public information desk should display translated forms because some visitors cannot read the original language.
items.why: allow visitors to understand 解释翻译如何帮助填表；they must answer 限定 questions。

items.stem: Practice emergency drills could help workers learn the exit route before an actual alarm.
items.lead: For example, a new worker could
items.why: 具体行动是 learn which corridor leads to the nearest exit；说明的是提前认识路线，不是保证不会发生事故。

items.stem: A pre-order system could help a bakery plan quantities before preparing bread.
items.why: count the orders to estimate the required quantity 展示预订信息如何用于备货。
